The bug was likely caused by the `exec` function not properly handling the `N_FUNCTION` node type, which could lead to unintended behavior or errors during the execution of the abstract syntax tree (AST). Here is the patch:
 
 static
 void
 exec(const Ast *ast) {
 //printf("executing "); pn(ast);
 	Value *v;
 	switch(ast->class) {
 	case N_BLOCK:
 		block(ast);
 		return;
 	case N_IF:
 		ifstat(ast);
 		return;
 	case N_WHILE:
 		whilestat(ast);
 		return;
 	case N_DECLARATION:
 		declaration(ast);
 		return;
+	case N_FUNCTION:
+		return;
 	case N_RETURN:
 		returnstat(ast);
 		return;
 	case N_CALL:
 	case N_ASSIGNMENT:
 	case N_IDENTIFIER:
 	case N_NEG:
 	case N_NOT:
 	case N_EQ:
 	case N_NEQ:
 	case N_AND:
 	case N_IOR:
 	case N_XOR:
 	case N_LT:

 	case N_SUB:

 	case N_DIV:

 	case N_MOD:
 	case N_BOOLEAN:
 	case N_INTEGER:
 	case N_FLOAT:
 	case N_STRING:
 	case N_SET:
 	case N_R:
 		v = eval(ast);
 do { print_tree(stdout, ast); printf(" evaluates to "); pv(v); } while(0);
 		value_free(v);
 		return;
 	}
 printf("EXECFAIL %d ", ast->class); pn(ast);
 	assert(false && "should not be reached");
 }
